title: institutional-kb: institution-supplied sources
description: Index of institution-supplied sources (faculty/school guidance, module documents, programme lists) - multi-institution; entries carry an institution identifier. Cardiff Met is the first tenant, not the definition (S1-D8). Sensitivity is first-class: module documents are not public. Entries index and characterise sources; they never duplicate source text (F9). New edition = new entry + supersededBy on the old. Designed away-week Session 4 (S4-D1-D6).

id.description: Institution-prefixed by convention (cardiff-met/programme-list-2026). Prefix is legibility only; matching uses the institution field, never id parsing (S4-D2).

issuer.description: Issuing office, faculty, or school within the institution.

institution.description: Institution identifier slug, matched against facetSet.institution (S4-D5: ninth facet confirmed as string identifier; provisional lifted). E.g. cardiff-met.

sensitivity.description: Required on every entry - forces the sensitivity question (S1-D8's sensitivity line). Module documents are internal or restricted.

issuerVersion.description: The document's own version where the institution versions it. Presence requires retrieved.

sourceType.description: DELIBERATELY open pre-sourcing (S4-D3). Expected values: guidance, module-document, programme-list.

authorityLevel.description: institutional-kb's half of the four-level vocabulary (S1-D8 per store; S4-D4). authorityLevel=module requires scope.module (if/then below).

scope.description: Institutional grain the entry is issued at. Matching is most-specific-first: module beats school beats faculty (same walk-up spirit as S1-D9's subject axis).
